content: Unauthenticated MCP servers with write access (CVE-2025-49596, CVSS 9.4) require strict schema validation (additionalProperties: false), rate limiting per client (e.g., 10 ops/min), audit logging for all writes, and human-in-the-loop for high-risk operations. Schema validation at MCP layer is not enough; must validate at tool handler level. Separate read/write tools explicitly. AI agents can hallucinate or be prompt-injected into malformed tool invocations.
